muclient.script: local started, cycles, rendered, failures = nil, 0, 0, 0 local initialized, last_tick = false, nil local report = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. '.results.txt' local image = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Balerion300/mushclient/codex/inline-static-images/tests/fixture-scene.png' local pueblo = WorldName() == 'Inline images - Pueblo test' local function record(message) local f = assert(io.open(report, 'a')); f:write(message, '\n'); f:close() end function OnPluginInstall() assert(GetAlphaOption('site') == '127.0.0.1') assert(not IsConnected()) local f = assert(io.open(report, 'w')); f:close() SetOption('max_output_lines', 200) started = os.time() record('START transcript soak; disconnected simulated input only') end function OnPluginTick() if not started then return end if last_tick == os.time() then return end last_tick = os.time() if not initialized then if pueblo then SetOption('use_mxp', 0) SetOption('detect_pueblo', 1) Simulate('This world is Pueblo 1.10 enhanced.\r\n') else SetOption('use_mxp', 2) end assert(GetInfo(104), 'simulated protocol did not activate') initialized = true SetOption('max_output_lines', 200) end local ready, loading = 0, 0 for line = 1, GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(line,14) then local state = GetLineInfo(line,18) if state == 1 then ready = ready + 1 elseif state == 0 then loading = loading + 1 else failures = failures + 1 end end end rendered = math.max(rendered,ready) local elapsed = os.time() - started if elapsed >= 600 then record(string.format('END cycles=%d ready_peak=%d failures=%d',cycles,rendered,failures)) if rendered > 0 and failures == 0 then record('PASS COMPLETE') else record('FAIL COMPLETE') end DeleteOutput(); started = nil; return end if cycles > 0 and cycles % 60 == 0 then DeleteOutput() end for i = 1, 5 do Simulate('SOAK paragraph before image\r\n') if pueblo then Simulate('\r\n') else Simulate('\027[1z\r\n') end Simulate('SOAK paragraph after image\r\n') end cycles = cycles + 1 if cycles % 30 == 0 then record(string.format('SAMPLE elapsed=%d cycles=%d ready=%d loading=%d lines=%d',elapsed,cycles,ready,loading,GetLinesInBufferCount())) end end
